system.description:
Interact Action: start levitating up to a height equal to your Move Distance. Doom +2 for every Combat Round you are airborne. Outside combat, Doom +1, with more at the Director's discretion if the flight is sustained.

SHIVER Core Rulebook p.67
system.summary: Interact Action: start levitating up to a height equal to your Move Distance. Doom +2 for every Combat Round you are airborne. Outside combat, Doom +1, with more at the Director's discretion if the flight is sustained.

automation.note: Maximum height = your Move Distance. In combat tick Doom +2 each round you stay airborne; outside combat tick Doom +1, more if the Director rules the flight is sustained.
